title: Fast Food
subtitle: 「快餐／快速供應食品」，要先分清是在談快餐店的服務模式、預製即食餐、外帶食品、方便食品，還是營養上不健康的 junk food。
description: 「快餐／快速供應食品」，要先分清是在談快餐店的服務模式、預製即食餐、外帶食品、方便食品，還是營養上不健康的 junk food。

words.example: The report compares quick-service food with full-service dining.
words.exampleZh: 報告比較快速服務食品與全服務餐飲。

exercises.original: The report compares fast food with full-service dining.
exercises.zh: 報告比較快餐與全服務餐飲。
exercises.upgrade: The report compares quick-service food with full-service dining.

options.explanation: full-service dining is an industry contrast, so quick-service food is the precise formal term。
snacks describe portion/meal size, not service model。
takeaway only describes where food is eaten。
ready meals are retail-prepared products, not necessarily restaurant food。
street food is defined by selling location。
processed food is a manufacturing category.

exercises.original: The company operates in the fast-food sector.
exercises.zh: 這家公司在快餐業營運。
exercises.upgrade: The company operates in the quick-service food sector.

options.explanation: sector/industry wording naturally favours quick-service food。
street-food sector is a different venue category。
ready-meal sector is mainly retail grocery。
snack is too narrow。
processed-food sector is far broader。
takeaway-only does not capture the restaurant business model.

exercises.original: Consumer spending on fast food increased last year.
exercises.zh: 消費者去年在快餐上的支出增加。
exercises.upgrade: Consumer spending on quick-service food increased last year.

options.explanation: market-spending context supports the industry category quick-service food。
junk food adds a negative nutritional judgement。
snacks are only one food type。
street food is venue-specific。
ready meals are retail products。
processed food is much broader.

words.example: Many commuters buy ready-made meals on the way home.
words.exampleZh: 很多通勤人士回家途中會購買即食餐。

exercises.original: Many commuters buy fast food from supermarkets on the way home.
exercises.zh: 很多通勤人士回家途中會在超市購買即食餐。
exercises.upgrade: Many commuters buy ready-made meals from supermarkets on the way home.

options.explanation: supermarket + meal ready to eat/heat is a classic ready-made meal context。
quick-service food usually refers to restaurant service。
snacks only are not necessarily full meals。
takeaway restaurant food comes from food outlets, not supermarkets by definition。
junk food is a nutritional judgement.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: She heated a fast-food meal from the fridge after work.
exercises.zh: 下班後，她把雪櫃裡的即食餐加熱。
exercises.upgrade: She heated a ready-made meal from the fridge after work.

options.explanation: heated from the fridge indicates a pre-prepared retail meal。
takeaway implies restaurant food bought to eat elsewhere。
snack is too small/limited。
street food does not fit home refrigeration。
quick-service meal is normally served by a QSR outlet。
freshly cooked meal contradicts ready-made.

exercises.original: The store sells fast food that only needs a few minutes in the microwave.
exercises.zh: 商店售賣只需微波數分鐘的即食餐。
exercises.upgrade: The store sells ready-made meals that only need a few minutes in the microwave.

options.explanation: microwave preparation after purchase is a direct ready-made-meal clue。
street food is sold by street vendors。
takeaway meals necessarily would imply restaurant preparation。
snacks need not be complete meals。
junk food says nothing about preparation method。
restaurant meals are not normally microwaved by the customer at home.

words.example: Busy households often rely on convenience food during the week.
words.exampleZh: 忙碌家庭平日經常依賴方便食品。

exercises.original: Busy households often rely on fast food because it saves preparation time.
exercises.zh: 忙碌家庭常依賴方便食品，因為可節省準備時間。
exercises.upgrade: Busy households often rely on convenience food because it saves preparation time.

options.explanation: saves preparation time is the defining convenience-food feature。
street food is venue-defined。
snacks only are too narrow。
takeaway only is one service mode。
junk food adds a health judgement。
fresh produce often requires preparation and is not convenience food by default.

exercises.original: The supermarket expanded its fast-food range for time-poor customers.
exercises.zh: 超市為時間緊迫的顧客擴充方便食品種類。
exercises.upgrade: The supermarket expanded its convenience-food range for time-poor customers.

options.explanation: supermarket + time-poor customers strongly supports convenience food。
quick-service restaurant food comes from restaurant outlets。
street food is a different channel。
snacks only are just one subgroup。
junk food is a nutritional label。
raw ingredients do not usually reduce preparation time.

exercises.original: Frozen meals are one type of fast food designed for convenience.
exercises.zh: 冷凍餐是為方便而設的一種方便食品。
exercises.upgrade: Frozen meals are one type of convenience food designed for convenience.

options.explanation: frozen meals designed to minimise prep are convenience food by definition。
street food and takeaway describe selling/eating channels。
junk food concerns nutritional quality。
snack is a portion category。
fresh restaurant food is not necessarily packaged convenience food.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

words.example: We ordered takeaway food after working late.

exercises.original: We ordered fast food after working late and ate it at home.
exercises.zh: 我們加班後叫外賣回家吃。
exercises.upgrade: We ordered takeaway food after working late and ate it at home.

options.explanation: ordered + ate at home indicates restaurant food taken away。
ready-made supermarket meals are retail products rather than restaurant takeaway。
street food is bought from street vendors。
snacks are too narrow。
junk food adds nutritional judgement。
processed food is a manufacturing category.

exercises.original: The restaurant gets much of its business from fast food collected by customers.
exercises.zh: 餐廳很多生意來自顧客自取外賣。
exercises.upgrade: The restaurant gets much of its business from takeaway food collected by customers.

options.explanation: restaurant + collected by customers is clearly takeaway service。
ready meals are usually retail-prepared products。
snacks do not capture full meal orders。
street food is a venue category。
processed food is too broad。
junk food is nutritional evaluation.

exercises.original: They bought fast food and took it back to the office.
exercises.zh: 他們買了外賣並帶回辦公室。
exercises.upgrade: They bought takeaway food and took it back to the office.

options.explanation: took it back to the office is direct takeaway context。
ready-made meal necessarily assumes retail pre-preparation。
street food necessarily assumes a street vendor。
junk food adds health judgement。
snack is too narrow。
processed food is unrelated to where it is eaten.

words.example: The station has several outlets selling fast-service meals.
words.exampleZh: 車站有數個售賣快速供應餐點的店舖。

exercises.original: The station has several outlets selling fast food for passengers in a hurry.
exercises.zh: 車站有數個店舖為趕時間乘客售賣快速供應餐點。
exercises.upgrade: The station has several outlets selling fast-service meals for passengers in a hurry.

options.explanation: outlets + passengers in a hurry emphasises speed of service。
ready meals only would imply pre-packaged retail products。
street food depends on venue。
snacks only are too narrow。
processed food is a production category。
junk food adds nutritional judgement.

exercises.original: The airport offers many fast-food options for travellers with little time.
exercises.zh: 機場為時間不多的旅客提供多種快速供應餐點。
exercises.upgrade: The airport offers many fast-service meal options for travellers with little time.

options.explanation: airport + little time + meal options fits a descriptive fast-service label。
street food is location-defined and not typical airport terminology。
ready-made supermarket meals are too channel-specific。
snacks only exclude full meals。
junk food adds judgement。
processed food is broader.

exercises.original: Workers often choose fast food when lunch breaks are short.
exercises.zh: 午膳時間短時，員工常選快速供應餐點。
exercises.upgrade: Workers often choose fast-service meals when lunch breaks are short.

options.explanation: short lunch break makes speed of service the key feature。
junk food focuses nutrition。
street food focuses venue。
ready meals only is too narrow。
snacks may not be sufficient as meals。
processed food is unrelated to serving speed.

words.meaning: 即買即走食品；便攜快食
words.example: The café offers sandwiches and salads in its grab-and-go section.
words.exampleZh: 咖啡店在即買即走區提供三文治和沙律。

exercises.original: The café sells fast food that customers can pick up immediately.
exercises.zh: 咖啡店售賣可即取即走的食品。
exercises.upgrade: The café sells grab-and-go food that customers can pick up immediately.

options.explanation: pick up immediately is the defining grab-and-go feature。
street food is sold at street stalls, not necessarily cafés。
ready-made meal necessarily may overlap but can also require heating at home。
junk food says nothing about pick-up speed。
sit-down meals contradict the format。
raw ingredients are not ready for immediate eating.

exercises.original: The shop has a fridge of fast food for commuters.
exercises.zh: 商店有一個雪櫃擺放供通勤人士即買即走的食品。
exercises.upgrade: The shop has a fridge of grab-and-go food for commuters.

options.explanation: fridge + commuters + immediate purchase is classic grab-and-go retail。
street food is venue-defined。
takeaway restaurant food is ordered/prepared through a restaurant。
junk food adds a nutritional label。
raw food is not necessarily ready to eat。
sit-down dining is the opposite format.

exercises.original: Sandwiches and salads are sold as fast food near the station entrance.
exercises.zh: 車站入口附近售賣即買即走的三文治和沙律。
exercises.upgrade: Sandwiches and salads are sold as grab-and-go food near the station entrance.

options.explanation: sandwiches/salads + station + immediate purchase fits grab-and-go。
junk food would wrongly imply poor nutritional quality。
street food necessarily is too venue-specific。
processed food says nothing about retail format。
restaurant takeaway only is too narrow。
snacks only may not include full lunch salads/sandwiches.

words.meaning: 預先製作食品；預製食品
words.example: The outlet uses pre-prepared food to reduce waiting times.
words.exampleZh: 店舖使用預製食品以縮短等候時間。

exercises.original: The outlet uses fast food prepared in advance to reduce waiting times.
exercises.zh: 店舖使用預製食品以縮短等候時間。
exercises.upgrade: The outlet uses pre-prepared food to reduce waiting times.

options.explanation: prepared in advance is the direct definition of pre-prepared food。
street food concerns selling venue。
raw ingredients are not prepared in advance as meals。
freshly cooked only contradicts pre-prepared。
snacks are a portion category。
junk food is a nutritional judgement.

exercises.original: Some ingredients in fast-food outlets are prepared before opening.
exercises.zh: 部分快餐店食材會在開店前預先處理。
exercises.upgrade: Some ingredients in quick-service outlets are pre-prepared before opening.

options.explanation: prepared before opening describes advance preparation directly。
processed food necessarily may be industrially altered, which is a different concept。
takeaway food is about where it is eaten。
junk food is nutritional judgement。
ready meal refers to a complete meal rather than ingredients.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: The kitchen relies on fast food prepared earlier during busy periods.
exercises.zh: 廚房在繁忙時段依賴較早預製的食品。
exercises.upgrade: The kitchen relies on pre-prepared food during busy periods.

options.explanation: earlier preparation for peak demand is exactly pre-prepared food。
street food is venue-defined。
raw ingredients are not prepared food。
junk food is not a preparation method。
snacks are too narrow。
sit-down food describes dining mode, not preparation.

words.example: The supermarket expanded its prepared-food section.

exercises.original: The supermarket expanded its fast-food counter.
exercises.zh: 超市擴充了熟食櫃位。
exercises.upgrade: The supermarket expanded its prepared-food counter.

options.explanation: supermarket counter selling already made dishes is prepared food。
raw food is the opposite preparation state。
street food is venue-defined。
junk food adds a nutritional judgement。
snack-only is too narrow。
takeaway-only describes consumption location rather than preparation.

exercises.original: Customers can choose from hot fast food at the deli counter.
exercises.zh: 顧客可在熟食櫃選購熱食。
exercises.upgrade: Customers can choose from hot prepared food at the deli counter.

options.explanation: deli counter + already cooked hot dishes fits prepared food。
street food is sold from street vendors。
raw ingredients are uncooked components。
junk food is a nutritional judgement。
ready meal only usually implies packaged retail meals。
snacks are too narrow.

exercises.original: Sales of fast food in supermarkets have grown.
exercises.zh: 超市熟食銷售有所增長。
exercises.upgrade: Sales of prepared food in supermarkets have grown.

options.explanation: supermarket sales category naturally uses prepared food。
quick-service restaurant food is a restaurant sector category。
street food is venue-defined。
junk food is narrower/judgemental。
snacks only exclude meals。
raw produce is not prepared food.

words.meaning: 外帶即食食品；便攜食品
words.example: Demand for food to go is high around major stations.
words.exampleZh: 大型車站附近對外帶即食食品的需求很高。

exercises.original: Demand for fast food is high around major stations.
exercises.zh: 大型車站附近對外帶即食食品的需求很高。
exercises.upgrade: Demand for food to go is high around major stations.

options.explanation: stations + commuters + portable meals is classic food-to-go retail usage。
street food depends on vendor location。
sit-down dining is opposite portability。
raw groceries are not immediate meals。
junk food adds nutritional judgement。
ready meals only are one subgroup.

exercises.original: Retailers are expanding their fast-food ranges for commuters.
exercises.zh: 零售商正在擴充供通勤人士購買的外帶即食食品。
exercises.upgrade: Retailers are expanding their food-to-go ranges for commuters.

options.explanation: retailers + commuters + range is standard food-to-go market language。
restaurant dining is not retail grab-and-go。
street food is a venue category。
raw produce is not ready to eat as a meal。
junk food adds judgement。
snacks only is too narrow.

exercises.original: The shop redesigned its fast-food section near the entrance.
exercises.zh: 商店重新設計入口附近的外帶即食食品區。
exercises.upgrade: The shop redesigned its food-to-go section near the entrance.

options.explanation: retail section near entrance for immediate purchase fits food to go。
street-food section would imply street-vendor style。
raw-food section is different merchandise。
junk-food section is a nutritional category。
sit-down is not a retail section type here。
processed-food is too broad.

words.example: We grabbed a quick meal before the train left.
words.exampleZh: 火車開出前，我們快速吃了一餐。

exercises.original: We had fast food before the train left.
exercises.zh: 火車開出前，我們快速吃了一餐。
exercises.upgrade: We had a quick meal before the train left.

options.explanation: before the train left means the key idea is limited time, not a specific food category。
snack necessarily is too small; it may have been a full meal。
junk food adds a health judgement。
takeaway necessarily assumes eating elsewhere。
ready-made meal necessarily assumes advance preparation。
street food assumes a particular sales venue.

exercises.original: She prepared fast food at home before an evening class.
exercises.zh: 她上夜課前在家快速準備了一餐。
exercises.upgrade: She prepared a quick meal at home before an evening class.

options.explanation: prepared at home + limited time fits quick meal, not restaurant fast food。
takeaway is bought from an outlet。
street food is vendor-based。
junk food is nutritional judgement。
ready-made meal necessarily may be possible but is not stated。
snack only is too narrow.

exercises.original: They stopped for fast food during the short break.
exercises.zh: 短休期間，他們快速吃了一餐。
exercises.upgrade: They stopped for a quick meal during the short break.

options.explanation: short break makes speed the only required meaning。
junk food adds nutritional assumptions。
ready-made meal assumes preparation method。
street food assumes venue。
takeaway only assumes off-site consumption。
snack necessarily may underestimate a full meal.

words.meaning: 垃圾食品；高糖高脂低營養食品
words.example: Health campaigns often encourage people to cut down on junk food.
words.exampleZh: 健康宣傳經常鼓勵人們減少進食垃圾食品。

exercises.original: Health campaigns often encourage people to reduce unhealthy fast food.
exercises.zh: 健康宣傳常鼓勵人們減少進食不健康的垃圾食品。
exercises.upgrade: Health campaigns often encourage people to cut down on junk food.

options.explanation: unhealthy + health campaign points to nutritional quality, hence junk food。
takeaway food can be healthy or unhealthy。
ready-made meals vary nutritionally。
street food is venue-defined。
food to go is format-based。
prepared food is a broad retail category.

exercises.original: The article criticises fast food that is high in salt, sugar, and fat.
exercises.zh: 文章批評高鹽、高糖、高脂的垃圾食品。
exercises.upgrade: The article criticises junk food that is high in salt, sugar, and fat.

options.explanation: high salt/sugar/fat is a direct junk-food clue。
takeaway does not imply poor nutrition。
quick-service food is a service category。
ready-made meal may be nutritionally balanced。
street food depends on venue。
prepared food is much broader.

exercises.original: Parents were advised to limit children's fast food and sugary snacks.
exercises.zh: 家長獲建議限制兒童進食垃圾食品和含糖小食。
exercises.upgrade: Parents were advised to limit children's junk food and sugary snacks.

options.explanation: limit + sugary snacks + health context supports junk food。
takeaway food can be balanced meals。
food to go describes portability。
ready-made meals may be healthy。
street food is venue-defined。
prepared food is neutral and broad.

words.example: Some fast-food items are also highly processed foods.
words.exampleZh: 部分快餐食品同時屬高度加工食品。

exercises.original: Some fast-food products contain many additives and refined ingredients.
exercises.zh: 部分快餐產品含有很多添加劑和精製成分。
exercises.upgrade: Some fast-food products are highly processed foods containing many additives and refined ingredients.

options.explanation: many additives/refined ingredients directly concerns processing level。
takeaway food is service mode。
street food is venue-defined。
fresh food tends to contrast with highly processed food。
quick meal is about speed。
prepared food can be minimally processed.

exercises.original: The study measured intake of fast food made from heavily industrially processed ingredients.
exercises.zh: 研究量度由高度工業加工成分製成的食品攝取量。
exercises.upgrade: The study measured intake of highly processed food.

options.explanation: heavily industrially processed is the definition-level clue。
food to go/takeaway/street food classify service/location。
quick-service food classifies restaurant service model。
ready meals necessarily may overlap but are not defined solely by processing.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: Researchers distinguished fresh meals from fast food with extensive industrial processing.
exercises.zh: 研究人員把新鮮餐點和高度加工食品分開。
exercises.upgrade: Researchers distinguished fresh meals from highly processed food.

options.explanation: fresh vs extensive industrial processing is the key distinction。
takeaway/food to go describe where food is eaten。
quick meal describes time。
street food describes venue。
prepared food may still be fresh and minimally processed.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

words.meaning: 快速服務餐；快餐店餐點
words.example: The survey compared the price of quick-service meals across several chains.
words.exampleZh: 調查比較數個連鎖品牌的快餐價格。

exercises.original: The survey compared the price of fast food across several restaurant chains.
exercises.zh: 調查比較數個連鎖品牌的快餐價格。
exercises.upgrade: The survey compared the price of quick-service meals across several restaurant chains.

options.explanation: restaurant chains + meal prices is precisely quick-service-meal industry language。
ready-made meals are typically retail grocery products。
street food is sold through a different channel。
junk food is nutritional evaluation。
snacks are only one food size/category。
prepared supermarket food is a retail category.

exercises.original: Families spent more on fast food from major chains last year.
exercises.zh: 家庭去年在大型連鎖快餐上的支出增加。
exercises.upgrade: Families spent more on quick-service meals from major chains last year.

options.explanation: major chains strongly indicates QSR meals。
ready meals are supermarket-oriented。
food to go only is broader/different and includes retail sandwiches。
street food is a different sales channel。
junk food necessarily adds judgement not stated。
snacks are too narrow.

exercises.original: The study compared calories in fast food from different chains.
exercises.zh: 研究比較不同連鎖店快餐的卡路里。
exercises.upgrade: The study compared calories in quick-service meals from different chains.

options.explanation: different chains + whole meals fits quick-service meals。
ready-made meals are retail packaged meals。
street food is venue-defined。
takeaway only describes consumption mode。
prepared food is broader and may come from supermarkets。
junk food necessarily adds a negative nutritional classification rather than simply naming the meal source.

falseSynonyms.zh: 小食不等於 fast food snack 是餐與餐之間或少量食物；快餐通常可以構成完整一餐。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A snack is small; fast food can be a full meal.

falseSynonyms.zh: 外賣不等於 fast food takeaway 描述購買後帶走的方式；外賣可以是任何菜系和價位。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Takeaway describes service mode, not food type.

falseSynonyms.zh: 即食餐不等於 fast food ready meal 多指超市／零售預製餐；fast food 常指快餐店快速供應的餐點。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Ready meals and fast food overlap but are not identical.

falseSynonyms.zh: 垃圾食品不等於 fast food junk food 是營養評價；fast food 是供應形式或餐飲類別。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Junk food concerns nutritional quality, not service speed.

falseSynonyms.zh: 街頭食品不等於 fast food street food 由街頭攤販出售；可以快速，也可以現場慢煮。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Street food is defined by venue, not speed.

falseSynonyms.zh: 方便食品比 fast food 更廣 便利食品包括冷凍餐、罐頭、即食包裝食品等。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Convenience food includes many products not sold by fast-food outlets.

falseSynonyms.zh: 加工食品不等於 fast food processed food 是加工程度分類，範圍非常廣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Processing level and restaurant service format are different categories.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性與結構陷阱 fast 是形容詞／副詞；fast food 是固定名詞片語。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Fast describes speed; fast food names a food/service category.
